exact: high affinity basic amino acid transmembrane transporter activity
broad: high-affinity basic amino acid transporter activity

definition: Enables the transfer of basic amino acids from one side of a membrane to the other. Acidic amino acids have a pH above 7. In high-affinity transport the transporter is able to bind the solute even if it is only present at very low concentrations.
label: high-affinity basic amino acid transmembrane transporter activity
